positives.expected: Reader outputs equal separately held original bytes, exact text and metadata; order retained.
Typed metadata v2 preserved as unverified bytes and data; complete source and explanation recovered exactly.
Whitespace and escaped JSON keys allowed with independently replaced pin; raw metadata bytes preserved.

negative_expectation: Explicit ExportReadError or nonzero CLI; no accepted output remains; never execute any embedded string.
negatives: old pin after coherent export replacement
boundary_tests: source aggregate exactly65536 accepted when total within cap
total exactly131072 accepted when independently populated valid metadata permits it

baseline.kind: Original files plus independently held SHA256 index; same source bytes, explanation and metadata; ordinary exact copy and hash verification.
baseline.comparison: Byte equality only. This development comparator measures reader correctness; no task-time, cost, compaction or behavioral advantage claim.

independence.implementer: Fresh context sees format contract and engineering controls only; no producer/core/tests.
independence.oracle: Owner writes independent tests from frozen outcomes; actual installed producer used only to create compatible positive exports.

claim_ceiling: Pinned-export integrity and exact selected artifact recovery; original byte comparison separately performed by harness. Not source authentication, semantic fidelity, complete external endpoint or human validation.
